The control arm's mean_policy_kl_to_anchor_recent is a 0.0 SENTINEL, not a measurement. That is why the dose-response had to carry the whole burden of proving the anchor bound, and why one anomalous cell could vacate a passing load-bearing criterion. Fix the control before adding seeds.
